summary: The proposed patch addresses the issue of setting a session header to None, but it introduces a new line of code that may have unintended side effects.

issues.description: The patch removes all headers with a value of None from the merged settings, which could unintentionally remove other headers set to None elsewhere in the codebase, potentially breaking existing behavior.

The patch does not include additional tests to verify that it correctly handles the case where a session header is explicitly set to None, nor does it address the documentation to reflect the expected behavior.
